task.description: Write the tests of the questionnaire page REQ-057 (the page is built and passed the security and review gates; all code in tools/src/picker/public/ is final for this step). Source: docs/design/REQ-057-picker-page.md — section 13.2 (table of replacements З1-З16: which released tests are replaced and by what), sections 16-17 (criterion -> test table and the catalog of tests QP-*, QM-*, QS-* in picker-page.test.js, picker-page-model.test.js, picker-page-static.test.js), section 19 (traps), section 20 (the mutants of the project), section 15 (failure paths), D19 and the rules of 5.2 (L1-L4, Q6, R2), decisions/0077 and decisions/0078 (items 1-14), and the requirement REQ-057 in docs/requirements.yaml (all criteria, including the card criterion 11). The review and security reports to use (their lists "for TEST-DESIGNER"): handoffs/PAGE057-20261021-01/step-05-security-reviewer.json and step-05b-reviewer.json, step-04-code-fixer.json issue I2. Do: (1) replace the 8 released tests that fail on the old stub (LG-10c, SF-6c, SU-10, SU-11, SV-1f, SV-7e, TR-4b, TR-4e) exactly by the table З1-З16 — each replacement checks the same fact for the real page files; the derived reds HO-46, HO-47, HC-RT-1e must become green by that; (2) write every test of the catalog 17.1-17.3, with independent oracles (the expected values come from the requirement, the tenant data, validateTenant and the engine, not from copying page code); (3) the observable states the reviewers named: fieldset disabled during the request, discard of a language press before "Show the result" and on the result before Back/Start again, one POST on a double click, the limits of net.js at the boundaries against validateTenant (including emoji and spaces at the edges), the fragment kept on language change, "Repeat" only in the load block; (4) every failure-path test checks that state is unchanged; (5) tests run in a headless way on the document model the design describes (no real browser here; the real Chrome run is the next step); (6) apply the mutants of section 20 to a copy outside the project (fresh copy, never checkout/reset/stash/clean in the project) and prove each is killed; list the numbers in result; (7) do not change anything outside tools/test (and tools/test/fixtures if the design says so); if a test shows a real bug of the page, do not fix the code: write it in result.issues with the exact place and the failing test stays red only if the design says it must (otherwise tell ORCH). Final: cd tools && npm run check — the goal is zero red tests; say honestly which are red and why. Handoff text in English (decisions/0080). No git checkout/reset/stash/clean, no commits.

result.summary:
Tests of the questionnaire page REQ-057 written and the 8 released tests replaced by the table Z1-Z16. 97 new tests: picker-page.test.js 62 (54 of the catalogue 17.1 plus QP-0a, QP-0b, QP-2j, QP-5a2, QP-7g, QP-9f2, QP-9i, QP-9j), picker-page-model.test.js 23 (19 of 17.2 plus QM-2e, QM-4d, QM-6a, QM-6b), picker-page-static.test.js 12 (QS-1..QS-12). The page runs headless on a strict model of the document (tools/test/picker-page-dom.js: only the surface of design 10.3, anything else is a TypeError; a control in a shut fieldset takes no event and no focus; a number field gives value '' and badInput for a text that is not a number) with a controllable fetch (holds, one-shot rules, signals), localStorage (records every call, refuses on demand), location, history, scrollTo. Oracles: the tenant files, the table PAGE_TEXTS (literals), the engine and the validator of tenant files for the equality and limit tests, the tests' own visibility and progress rules; nothing is taken from the page. Result of the run: npm run check - 1995 tests, 1994 pass, 1 fail (QP-9f2, a real defect of the page, issue I1), skipped 0, todo 0. The derived reds HO-46, HO-47, HC-RT-1e and the 8 reds of the stub are green. Mutants: all 94 of design section 20 (M1..M92, with M91 and M92 each in two forms) killed; 28 of my own 30 killed, 2 equivalent (I3).

issues.text: A real defect of the page found by the test QP-9f2 (red, left red on purpose: not weakened, not skipped). Place: tools/src/picker/public/app.js, function newVersion(): ui.head = makeHead() is called BEFORE commitLanguage(); makeHead() builds the header with state.lang, which still is the OLD language, and commitLanguage() (which sets state.lang = state.q.lang) does not rebuild the header. Result: when a change of the language brings another version of the questionnaire (card with the notice), the button of the new language does not get aria-current="true" (the old one keeps it) and the group is named in the old language (aria-label 'Язык' instead of 'Тіл'), while the name and the texts are already in the new language. Violates the requirement (criterion 9: the current language has aria-current) and design 4.7. Repro: QP-9f2 (open uchet-pro, answer the first question, press 'Қазақша' while the server answers another version). Needs CODE-FIXER (for example commitLanguage() before makeHead(), or setHeadLanguage(ui.head, state.lang, state.q.name) after it), then SECURITY-REVIEWER and REVIEWER again, then the test goes green without change. The design does not say that this test must stay red; ORCH decides.

Design 17.1, QP-11d asks for one card with the notice AND the buttons 'Continue' and 'Start over'. The page cannot make this state: the notice appears only when the saved answers were wiped (so there is no 'Continue'). QP-11d therefore checks the two cards separately (notice + 'Take the survey'; saved answers + 'Continue' + 'Start over'), each in the order of design 10.2.

Two of my own mutants survive and are equivalent in the observable behaviour: X6 (the guard 'if (state.sending) return' at the start of send() removed) - send() is called only from advance() and from the retry button, advance() has the same guard and the retry block is removed while the request is on its way, so the inner guard is redundant; X27 (showResult for bodyAnswers(state.answers) instead of the snapshot) - the fields are shut during the request, so the answers cannot differ, and the temporary result.js does not read ctx.answers. REQ-058 should add a test of ctx.answers when it reads them.

Texts: the expected texts are the table PAGE_TEXTS in picker-page-helpers.js (literals). It holds the values after the readers' round 1 of step 07 (card_changed.kk 'Өтінеміз, қайтадан бастаңыз.', progress_label.kk 'Сұрақ {current} / {total}', net_lost_unsaved.en), not the first proposal of design section 14 (progress_label.kk there is '{total} сұрақтың {current}-і'). QP-8a also compares texts.js with this table, so a later change of a translation needs a change of the table (the contract).

Small reinterpretations of the catalogue text, no weakening: QM-1a does not measure time (no clock in tests; a guard timeout of the runner stays); QM-1e: the sentence 'the result ok equals whether the engine takes the integer' cannot hold literally for '1e3' (Number gives 1000, the page refuses the text), so the test checks that every text the page accepts gives the number the engine takes, and every text it refuses is not a plain whole number; QP-9d keeps '2.5' (a text that a number field returns), because a real browser returns '' for a text with badInput.

Observation, not a defect by the design (10.2): on the first question of a file whose later questions depend on it, with nothing answered yet, the main button is 'Show the result' (no visible question follows until the answer opens one); it becomes 'Next' after the answer (QP-2h pins this). Pressing it without an answer gives the 'required' message, so nothing is sent. The owner may want 'Next' there.
The demo server on port 4782 was not touched. No code outside tools/test changed; the file docs/design/REQ-057-picker-page.md and public/texts.js were already modified by earlier steps (not by me).
